aliasBoundary: esbuild aliases replace only next/navigation and @/lib/trips/archiv-aktionen. Collection, card, archive button, copy and project CSS stay real. The navigation shim returns void and has no arrival generation. No deployed route, account session, or Supabase client.
fixtureBoundary: Synthetic local Playwright. push and refresh do not change the URL or props. The script sets useSearchParams and passes a new result object only when it wants a server snapshot. A resolved refresh is not a list observation.
rootFontNote: The 32px check sets font-size on documentElement. It is not native browser zoom, not a device, and not a screen reader.
correlationLimit: A changed URL or a new result object is an observation. It does not identify which gesture produced the server render. The 8000ms lease is a UI guard, not a read receipt.
